warnings: Grid 4 carries no RC column: the beams on it (B5A, B5B) hang on the cantilevers B4X/BX from grid 3; D4/E4 and D2/E2 are steel carport columns SC1 on C0 stubs.

Two lines are not dimensioned and were measured against the grid, both flagged: 1' (≈2.00, beam B2) and B' (≈6.20, beam B1 in bay 1-2). A'' (2.00) comes from S2's printed short span on S-08, and 2' (5.15) from B6X's printed 1.15 on S-10.
Architectural sheets were not dimension-swept (op04 time budget) — z_levels holds only the ground datum.
